end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the call when the caller says goodbye or has no more questions.

language_detection.name: language_detection
language_detection.description: Switch to the caller's language when they speak one of the supported languages.

criteria.name: answered_from_guides
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Every factual answer comes from the knowledge base or the webhook tool result. Mark failure if the agent states a fact that neither source supports.

criteria.name: stayed_in_scope
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent only discussed the topics its prompt allows and politely declined anything else.

criteria.name: replied_in_callers_language
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Each agent turn is in the language the caller used in the turn before it.

criteria.name: no_invented_figures
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Every number, fee, date or limit the agent gave appears in the knowledge base or the tool result.

criteria.name: offered_next_step
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent ended its answer with a concrete next step, such as an official source to check or a follow-up question.

topic.description: The main topic of the call. One of: jobs, salary, visa, schools, money, other.

language.description: The language the caller mostly used, as an ISO 639-1 code such as en or ar.

used_salary_tool.description: True if the agent called a webhook tool during the call.
